menu.label: More actions for {{task}}
menu.deleteShared: This project's tasks are kept on its team server, which does not delete tasks. Close the task instead.
menu.busy: Wait until the change under way is done.

stop.title: Stop the run of {{task}}?
stop.done: {{task}} has a run that has not ended. Confirming stops that run and marks {{task}} as Done. Its work stays on its branch.
stop.canceled: {{task}} has a run that has not ended. Confirming stops that run and sets {{task}} to Canceled. Its work stays on its branch.
stop.confirmDone: Stop run and mark as done

delete.title: Delete {{task}}?
delete.reading: Reading what goes with the task…

runs.none: {{task}} has no runs; its conversation and artifacts go with it.
runs.one: {{task}} goes with its run and the run's history (steps, transcripts, plans, approvals and usage), its conversation and artifacts.
runs.other: {{task}} goes with its {{count}} runs and their history (steps, transcripts, plans, approvals and usage), its conversation and artifacts.

projectMemories.one: 1 project memory record its agents wrote goes too.
projectMemories.other: {{count}} project memory records its agents wrote go too.

projectRules.one: 1 project approval rule approved in its runs goes too: later runs ask again.
projectRules.other: {{count}} project approval rules approved in its runs go too: later runs ask again.

blocking.one: 1 task it blocks is no longer linked to it.
blocking.other: {{count}} tasks it blocks are no longer linked to it.

delete.git: The worktrees its runs left are removed and their merged branches deleted. Merged work stays in your git history.

unmerged.title: Also remove work that is not merged

branches.one: 1 branch has commits that are not merged.
branches.other: {{count}} branches have commits that are not merged.

unmerged.kept: Left unticked, they stay in the repository.

delete.personOnly: Only a person deletes a task: input from an MCP client is not taken here.
